content.text: Stripe operates in 46 countries out of 195. PayPal can suspend your account for 180 days with no appeal. Lemon Squeezy, Gumroad, and Paddle inherit these restrictions. If you're in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, or Bangladesh, these platforms are not options—they're obstacles. This comparison examines the structural flaws of rented [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/get-payment-gateways-cameroon-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-minimum-viable-3|COREMERCH guide to digital]]-products-working-today|Get Payment]] infrastructure and why sovereign commerce stacks built on base-layer tools offer permanent alternatives. We analyze what each option actually delivers, how they fail restricted regions, and which [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-7|architecture]] digital creators should choose when conventional platforms exclude them by design.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Lemon squeezy

Stripe, PayPal, Lemon Squeezy, and Gumroad offer rented infrastructure. They control the payment processing, order storage, and delivery mechanisms. Your store depends on their APIs, their compliance teams, and their whims. Sovereign commerce stacks invert this. Tools like Cloudflare Pages, Supabase, and NOWPayments become your owned infrastructure. You deploy the code, you control the data, you configure the payment logic. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) exemplifies this: Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto processing. No platform dependency. No subscriptions. Full ownership after deployment.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal exclude countries based on geopolitical risk, not technical limitations. Lemon Squeezy and Gumroad inherit these restrictions because they rely on Stripe and PayPal. When a country is blocked, these platforms offer no recourse. Sovereign stacks bypass this entirely. By using open tools like Cloudflare and NOWPayments, you're not asking permission to operate. You deploy your stack in any country, accept 300+ cryptocurrencies through NOWPayments, and deliver products via your own infrastructure. The system doesn't care about your location—it's architecture, not geography, that determines access.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe charges 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. PayPal holds funds for up to 21 days in some regions. Crypto payments through NOWPayments cost 0.5% with no holding period. Transactions on BSC, Solana, or TRON cost under $0.10. The real cost of rented platforms isn't the fee—it's the risk of account suspension, fund holds, and sudden deplatforming. Sovereign stacks eliminate these risks. You configure your own payment logic, store orders in your own database, and deliver files from your own storage. The only fee is NOWPayments' 0.5%, and you own the entire system after deployment.
Rented platforms exclude you by design. Sovereign stacks include you by architecture.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With Stripe or PayPal, you rent access to their systems. Your data lives on their servers, your store depends on their APIs, and your delivery relies on their integrations. Sovereign stacks give you full ownership. Cloudflare Pages hosts your storefront, Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, Supabase stores your orders, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers your files. NOWPayments automatically verifies crypto payments and triggers delivery via webhook. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes end-to-end testing and 30-day support to ensure your system works flawlessly before handoff. After deployment, it's yours—no platform can shut it down.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you're in a country Stripe or PayPal supports, rented platforms might suffice—for now. But if you're in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, or Bangladesh, these platforms are non-options. Sovereign commerce stacks are the only permanent solution. Start with the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) if you're selling 3 products or fewer. Upgrade to the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for 5 products, SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration, and end-to-end testing. If you want to build your own, purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for all blueprints and templates. Deploy your stack, own your infrastructure, and never be locked out again.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, you cannot use Lemon Squeezy, Gumroad, or Paddle—they rely on Stripe for payments. The only permanent solution is to deploy your own sovereign commerce stack using open tools like Cloudflare Pages, Supabase, and NOWPayments. This gives you full ownership of your storefront, payment processing, and product delivery. Crypto payments through NOWPayments bypass geographic restrictions entirely, allowing you to sell to anyone, anywhere, without relying on rented infrastructure.
Crypto payments cost 0.5% with no holding period. Stripe and PayPal cost more and risk more.

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a complete, deployed solution in 48 hours. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to choose the stack that fits your needs. For those who prefer to build their own, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints and templates for instant download.
Your Deployment Checklist

Deploy your sovereign commerce stack in these steps: 1. Choose your hosting—Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. 2. Set up your backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 3. Configure your order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets. 4. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. 5. Test your system end-to-end to ensure automatic payment verification and product delivery. 6. Load your products and configure email deliverability with SPF/DKIM/DMARC. 7. Deploy your stack and take full ownership of your infrastructure.

PayPal operates in limited capacities in these countries, often without full withdrawal options. Even where available, account suspensions can hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal. Sovereign commerce stacks using NOWPayments for crypto processing bypass these restrictions entirely, offering permanent access without geographic limitations.

This architecture gives you full ownership and eliminates platform dependency, ensuring you can sell digital products regardless of your location.

NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee per transaction, with no additional costs. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON have transaction fees under $0.10. Compare this to Stripe's 2.9% + $0.30 and PayPal's potential fund holds—crypto payments are faster, cheaper, and more reliable for restricted regions.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?

NOWPayments operates as a payment processor, not a platform you depend on. If their service fails, you can switch to another crypto payment provider without losing your storefront or order data. Your sovereign stack remains operational because you own the infrastructure.
